high_level_description: The image is a line graph comparing the daily active users of Microsoft Teams and Slack from 2014 to 2020. The graph is titled "Microsoft Teams vs. Slack" and is sourced from "Company Announcements, VentureBeat, TechCrunch." The source is credited to "chartr." Axes: The x-axis represents the years from 2014 to 2020. The y-axis represents the number of daily active users in millions. Lines: A green line represents Slack, starting at nearly zero daily
